This includes any birds you keep as pets. APHA will provide you with a CPH number when you register. You should not apply for a country parish holding (CPH) number from the Rural Payments Agency (RPA) using this form.

If you already have a CPH number from keeping other livestock, call the RPA to get your CPH number updated to include keeping 50 poultry or other captive birds.

Rural Payments Agency

pages.title: Easting and northing for where you'll keep livestock

components.content:
The Rural Payments Agency (RPA) need the easting and northing for the main area where you'll keep livestock. For example, if you're a:

- pet owner, this might be a back yard, garden or piece of land attached to your house
- hobby livestock keeper, this might be a community allotment, back yard or a piece of land you own
- professional livestock keeper or farmer, this would be the gathering point on your farm yard or main field

## More than one location

If you keep livestock in more than one location, provide the main area first, then add the other locations on the next page using the 'Add another' button.
